supersession.reason: The measured W32 monolith exceeded the literal 100x target, while the operator separately authorized a shape-versatility workhorse through 100x surface. The former mandatory three-kernel micro graph and dense event prescription would rewrite the proven speed path without serving either requirement.
supersession.preserved_history: The superseded design remains reachable in Git history and in the retained independent audit ZIPs.
supersession.forbidden_interpretation: No declaration in this contract is runtime graph evidence or a qualification decision.

identity_split.attempt_identity: artifact identity plus immutable admitted B/K, exact ten-field live device identity including CUDA runtime, and exact live VRAM/reserve/headroom observation

topology.ranking: stable biological-UID ordering with O(C) or O(C log C) bounded work; no O(C squared) ranking

scratch.exact_formula_authority: source-derived per backend and per shape; the rejected B1/K1 formula is not inherited

first_execution_envelope.reference_seed: The retired B1/K1 monolithic gate is not authority; use the closed atomic semantic-case route before measured admitted batched candidates

semantic_evidence_contract.attempt_rule: one fresh ExecutionRequestV2, Run and Scheduler Attempt per case
semantic_evidence_contract.negative_rule: expected native negatives return sealed provisional evidence, then terminalize the Attempt FAILED at the exact case-law frontier; request VALID_NEGATIVE requires the terminal receipt and explicit R3 lifecycle commit
